import sys

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
p = list(map(int, input[1:n+1]))
assignment = input[n+1]

a_strength = sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'A')
b_strength = sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i) == 'B')

max_strength = b_strength
prefix_flip_strength = 0
suffix_flip_strength = 0

for i in range(n):
    if assignment[i] == 'A':
        prefix_flip_strength += p[i]
        suffix_flip_strength -= p[i]
    else:
        prefix_flip_strength -= p[i]
        suffix_flip_strength += p[i]
    max_strength = max(max_strength, b_strength + prefix_flip_strength, a_strength + suffix_flip_strength)

print(max_strength)
